description: This file defines the TileLayerWMS class for integrating WMS (Web Map Service) layers into a Leaflet map. It extends the TileLayer class, providing options and methods specific to WMS tile layers, including URL construction, parameter handling, and initialization.

classes.name: TileLayerWMS
classes.description: A class extending TileLayer to support WMS services as tile layers, with specific options and methods for WMS parameters, URL generation, and map integration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the WMS layer with URL and options, merging default parameters with user options, and handling retina displays.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Method called when the layer is added to the map, setting coordinate reference system and WMS version.

methods.name: getTileUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL for a specific tile based on coordinates, WMS parameters, and map projection.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Updates WMS request parameters and optionally redraws the layer.
